#### Load Data

```{r load data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
CA_CURTO_ROOT <- here::here("data", "external")

# read in count table
data<-read.table(here::here("data", "count_table.txt"),
                 header = TRUE, sep = '\t')

genus_data <- read.table(here::here("data", "GTDB_Genus_abundance_table.tsv"),
                 header = TRUE, sep = '\t')


# read mapping colors file
mapping_colors <- read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "isolates", "clade_colors.txt"),
                             header = T, sep = "\t", comment.char = "")
mapping_colors <- mapping_colors[-c(1:7),]
# get clade & subclade colors
# clade colors
clade_colors <- mapping_colors[grep("^(..|UND)$", mapping_colors$variable), ]

clds <- c("I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "UND")
clade_colors <- setNames(mapping_colors[match(clds, mapping_colors$variable),2], mapping_colors[match(clds, mapping_colors$variable),1])

subclds <- mapping_colors$variable[!mapping_colors$variable %in% clds]

subclade_colros <- setNames(mapping_colors[mapping_colors$variable %in% subclds, 2], mapping_colors[mapping_colors$variable %in% subclds, 1])

#rename column names with sample ID
colnames(data)<-sub("\\.", "-", colnames(data))
colnames(data)<-sub("\\.", "-", colnames(data))
data <- column_to_rownames(data, "genomeID")

colnames(genus_data)<-sub("\\.", "-", colnames(genus_data))
colnames(genus_data)<-sub("\\.", "-", colnames(genus_data))
genus_data <- column_to_rownames(genus_data, "genus")

# read DB metadata to rename DB genomes IDs with the actual genome ID.
dbmd <- read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "curto_core_genesDB", "masterMD4DB.txt"))
rownames(data) <- dbmd$V4[match(rownames(data), dbmd$V5)]

#now lets build the "taxonomy" table, levels: genus, clade, subclade
tax <- data.frame(rownames(data))
colnames(tax)[1] <- "genomeID"
#add the genus from de databas metadata
tax$genus <- dbmd$V1[match(tax$genomeID, dbmd$V4)]
# now lets load the genomes master metadata file to get clades and subclade info.
master_md <- read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "isolates", "master_md_all_sequenced_Isolates_with_extendedMD.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t")
#merge main db with taxonomy table but keeping only the matches in the taxonomy table
tax <- merge(tax, master_md[,c(2,3,9)], by.x = "genomeID", by.y = "Name", all.x = T)
tax <- column_to_rownames(tax, "genomeID")
tax <- as.matrix(tax)


#import metadata table
metadata<-read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "RTs", "RTs_sample_metadata.txt"), header = TRUE, sep = '\t', quote = "")

reserve_names <- unique(metadata$Reserve)

codenames <- c(
  "EMR",
  "MOJ",
  "COP",
  "SGWK",
  "BLOK",
  "BOMR",
  "McLL",
  "SNARL",
  "LOMA"
)

reserve_codenames <- data.frame(ReserveName = reserve_names, CodeName = codenames, color = reserve_colors)
color_mapping_vector <- setNames(reserve_codenames$color, reserve_codenames$CodeName)


metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(reserve_code = reserve_codenames$CodeName[match(metadata$Reserve, reserve_codenames$ReserveName)],
         s_code = reserve_codenames$CodeName[match(Substrate_reserve, reserve_codenames$ReserveName)],
         i_code = case_when(
           Inoculum_reserve == "none" ~ "none",
           TRUE ~ reserve_codenames$CodeName[match(Inoculum_reserve, reserve_codenames$ReserveName)]),
         r_home = case_when(Inoculum == "IX" ~ "none",
           Inoculum_reserve == Reserve ~ "home",
           TRUE ~ "away"),
         s_home = case_when(
                            # 1) If there *is* an inoculum, compare substrate → inoculum
                            Inoculum_reserve != "none" &
                              Substrate_reserve == Reserve  ~ "home",
                            Inoculum_reserve != "none" &
                              Substrate_reserve != Reserve  ~ "away",
                            
                            # 2) If inoculum == "none", compare substrate → reserve
                            Inoculum_reserve == "none" &
                              Substrate_reserve == Reserve           ~ "home",
                            TRUE                                    ~ "away"
                            ),
         i_home = case_when(
           Inoculum == "IX" ~ "none",
           Reserve == Inoculum_reserve ~ "home",
           TRUE ~ "away"
         )) |>
  unite(
    col       = "treatment", 
    c(Bag_type, s_home, i_home),
    sep       = "_",
    remove    = FALSE,    # keep the originals if you need them later
    na.rm     = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # make it a factor in the order you like
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, 
                            levels = c(
                              "Closed_home_home",
                              "Closed_home_away", # adjust to your real levels
                              "Closed_away_home",
                              "Closed_away_away",
                              "Closed_home_none",
                              "Closed_away_none",
                              "Open_away_none",
                              "Open_home_none"
                            ))) |>
  group_by(reserve_code, Bag_type, s_code, i_code) %>%
  mutate(
    replicate = factor(row_number())
  ) %>%
  ungroup() |>
  unite(
    col = "treatment_rep",
    c(treatment, replicate),
    sep = "_",
    remove = F,
    na.rm = T
  ) |>
  unite(
    col    = "treatment_2",
    c(reserve_code, s_code, i_code, Bag_type),
    sep    = "|",
    remove = FALSE
  )


count_table <- otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
taxonomy <- tax_table(tax)
sam_data <- sample_data(metadata)
sample_names(sam_data) <- metadata$original_label
rt <- phyloseq(count_table, taxonomy, sam_data)
rt


```


####### Litter chemistry data

```{r}
## read table ##
litter_chem <- read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "mg", "litter_chem", "litter_chem.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t", comment.char = "")

litter_chem <- litter_chem |>
  dplyr::select(-c(1:4,6:10)) |>
  mutate(
    sampleID = gsub("^#\\d+\\s+", "", desc_1)
    ) |>
  dplyr::select(-desc_1) |>
  dplyr::select(sampleID, everything()) |>
  filter(sampleID != "SKIP")

litter_chem <- litter_chem |>
  mutate(
    # Create new sampleID by replacing the trailing '1' with '3' and '2' with '4'
    new_sampleID = case_when(
      grepl("1$", sampleID) ~ sub("1$", "3", sampleID),
      grepl("2$", sampleID) ~ sub("2$", "4", sampleID),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # To handle cases where neither condition applies
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(new_sampleID)) |>  # Ensure only valid rows are used
  bind_rows(  # Bind the original and new rows together
    litter_chem |>
      mutate(
        sampleID = case_when(
          grepl("1$", sampleID) ~ sub("1$", "3", sampleID),
          grepl("2$", sampleID) ~ sub("2$", "4", sampleID),
          TRUE ~ sampleID
        )
      )) |>
  arrange(sampleID) %>%
  dplyr::select(sampleID, ADF, NDF, CP, Lignin, NFC, NSC) %>%
  mutate(cellulose = ADF - Lignin,
         hemicellulose = NDF - ADF,
         hemicellulose = pmax(hemicellulose, 0),
         Structural_Carbohydrates = NFC - NSC) %>% 
  filter(!sampleID %in% c("0.3", "#97")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sampleID, CP, cellulose, hemicellulose, Structural_Carbohydrates, Lignin) |>
  dplyr::rename(lignin = Lignin,
                crude_protein = CP) 

litt_chem_LOMA <- litter_chem |> filter(sampleID == "0.1")

litter_chem_agg <- litter_chem |>
  filter(sampleID != "0.1") |>
  #filter(grepl("^(02|26|32|23|35|08|11|36)D", sampleID) |
  #         sampleID == "0.1") |>
  mutate(sampleID = str_remove(sampleID, "\\d$")) |>
  group_by(sampleID) |>
  summarise(crude_protein = mean(crude_protein, na.rm = T),
            cellulose = mean(cellulose, na.rm = T),
            hemicellulose = mean(hemicellulose, na.rm = T),
            lignin = mean(lignin, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  bind_rows(litt_chem_LOMA) |> 
  select(-Structural_Carbohydrates) |>
  mutate(sampleID = case_when(sampleID == "0.1" ~ "LOMA",
                                T ~ sampleID))



pca_litt <- prcomp(litter_chem_agg |> column_to_rownames("sampleID")
            , center = T, scale. = T)
summary(pca_litt)

litt_dist <- as.matrix(dist(pca_litt$x))


litt_dists_toLOMA <- litt_dist |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("reserve") |>
  filter(reserve %in% c(paste0(c("23","26","32","35","02","08","11","36"), "D"))) |>
  dplyr::select(reserve, LOMA) |>
  rename(euc_litt_dist = LOMA  ) |>
  mutate(reserve_code = case_when(
      grepl("^02", reserve) ~ "BLOK",
      grepl("^23", reserve) ~ "EMR",
      grepl("^26", reserve) ~ "MOJ",
      grepl("^32", reserve) ~ "COP",
      grepl("^35", reserve) ~ "SGWK",
      grepl("^08", reserve) ~ "BOMR",
      grepl("^11", reserve) ~ "McLL",
      grepl("^36", reserve) ~ "SNARL",
       #add as many as you need ...
      TRUE                   ~ NA_character_  # default for anything that doesn't match
      )) |>
  left_join(litter_chem_agg |>
              filter(sampleID %in% c(paste0(c("23","26","32","35","02","08","11","36"), "D"), "LOMA")) |>
                left_join(pca_litt$x |> as.data.frame() |>
                                rownames_to_column("sampleID") |>
                                filter(sampleID %in% c(paste0(c("23","26","32","35","02","08","11","36"), "D"), "LOMA")) |>
                                select(sampleID,PC1,PC2),
                          by = "sampleID") |>
              mutate(PC1_LOMA_litt_dist           = abs(PC1[which(sampleID == "LOMA")]            - PC1),
                     PC2_LOMA_litt_dist           = abs(PC2[which(sampleID == "LOMA")]            - PC2),
                     PCsLOMA_litt_dist            = sqrt(
                       (PC1 - PC1[which(sampleID == "LOMA")])^2 +
                       (PC2 - PC2[which(sampleID == "LOMA")])^2),
                     CP_LOMA_litt_dist            = abs(crude_protein[which( sampleID == "LOMA")] - crude_protein),
                     cellulose_LOMA_litt_dist     = abs(cellulose[which(sampleID == "LOMA")]      - cellulose),
                     hemicellulose_LOMA_litt_dist = abs(hemicellulose[which(sampleID == "LOMA")]  - hemicellulose),
                     lignin_LOMA_litt_dist        = abs(lignin[which(sampleID == "LOMA")]         - lignin)) |>
                 filter(sampleID != "LOMA"),
            by = c("reserve" = "sampleID")) |>
  mutate(pair = paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA", sep = " ")) |>
  select(-reserve)
              



```


##### Normalize count table by total gene lengts by genome

```{r count table normalization, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}

gene_lengts_by_genome <- read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "curto_core_genesDB", "gene_lengths_by_genome.csv"), row.names = 1, header = T, sep = ",", check.names = F)


only_curto_gl <- gene_lengts_by_genome |>
  dplyr::select(any_of(as.data.frame(tax) |>
                        dplyr::filter(genus == "Curtobacterium") |>
                        row.names())
                )



db_top25names <- names(sort(colSums(only_curto_gl), decreasing = T)[1:100])
db_top25 <- as.data.frame(tax) |>
  dplyr::filter(row.names(tax) %in% db_top25names) |>
  rownames_to_column("rowname") %>% 
  mutate(rowname = factor(rowname, levels = db_top25names)) %>% 
  arrange(rowname) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("rowname") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(total_length_bp = sort(colSums(only_curto_gl), decreasing = T)[1:100])

base::table(db_top25$clade)
base::table(db_top25$subclade)


#dbgenes <- read.table("~/SyncFolder/CA_curto/curto_core_genesDB/DBgenes.txt")

#colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome) <- sub("^X", "", colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome))

#gene_lengts_by_genome <- gene_lengts_by_genome %>%
#  dplyr::filter(row.names(gene_lengts_by_genome) %in% dbgenes$V1)

colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome) <- dbmd$V4[match(colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome), dbmd$V3)]

# Extract genome and strain names
genome_names <- colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome)  # Or colnames(gene_lengths)
strain_names <- rownames(data)  # Or colnames(counts)

# Find inconsistencies
missing_in_gene_lengths <- setdiff(strain_names, genome_names)
missing_in_counts <- setdiff(genome_names, strain_names)

cat("Strains missing in gene_lengths:\n")
print(missing_in_gene_lengths)
cat("Genomes missing in counts:\n")
print(missing_in_counts)

data <- data[!rownames(data) %in% missing_in_gene_lengths,]

total_gene_lengths <- colSums(gene_lengts_by_genome)

total_gene_lengths <- total_gene_lengths[rownames(data)]

all.equal(names(total_gene_lengths), rownames(data))

rpk_table <- round(sweep(data, 1, total_gene_lengths, FUN = "/") * 1e6)

sort(colSums(rpk_table))

row.names(metadata) <- metadata$original_label

#check for mismatches in sample IDs between count table and metadata
missing_samples <- union(setdiff(rownames(metadata), colnames(rpk_table)), setdiff(colnames(rpk_table), rownames(metadata)))
# remove these samples from metadata
metadata <- metadata %>% filter(!(rownames(.) %in% missing_samples))

count_table<-otu_table(rpk_table, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
taxonomy<-tax_table(tax)
sam_data<-sample_data(metadata)
sample_names(sam_data) <- metadata$original_label
rt<-phyloseq(count_table, taxonomy, sam_data)
rt

### now let's just create a phyloseq table for the genus level table

genus_count_table <- otu_table(genus_data, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
rt_g <- phyloseq(genus_count_table, sam_data)
rt_g
```

### Total count and relative abundance plots

```{r total count and relative abundance plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
sequence_counts <- as.data.frame(sort(sample_sums(rt), decreasing = T))
colnames(sequence_counts)[1] <- "count"
sequence_counts$sampleID <- row.names(sequence_counts)

#total_counts <- read.table("~/SyncFolder/CA_curto/mg/total_prok_counts.txt", header = T)

metadata$sampleID <- metadata$original_label

count_summary <- sequence_counts %>%
  merge(., metadata, by = "sampleID") %>%
  arrange(count)


low_count_samples <- count_summary %>%
  filter(count < 100000) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sampleID) %>% pull()


total_count_plot <- ggplot(count_summary, aes(reorder(sampleID, count, decreasing = T), count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  #coord_flip() +   # This makes it a horizontal bar plot
  labs(title = "Curto total sequences in the each metgenomic library (after filteriring eukariotes)", x = "Sample", y = "# seqs") +
  #ggbreak::scale_y_cut(c(1000), which = c(2), scales = c(3, 0.5)) +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, hjust = 1), # Adjusts the y-axis labels (which are actually x because of coord_flip())
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)  # Adjusts the x-axis labels (which are actually y because of coord_flip())
  )

print(total_count_plot)
```

### Taxa Relative abundance plots (bar plots) 

```{r taxa_bps, echo=FALSE, fig.height=14, fig.width=30, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold'}
# first let's remove samples with zero reads
```

### Alpha Diversity Plots

```{r alpha diviersity plots, fig.width=30, fig.height = 14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#let's perform alpha rarefaction

# get your OTU table with taxa as colums and samples in rows, this lines to get your OTU table from a phyloseq object
curto_unrar_otutab <- as.data.frame(t(rtB4rar@otu_table))



#’ Calculate average richness (S) and Shannon diversity via repeated rarefaction ####
#’
#’ This function takes an unrarefied OTU table (samples × OTUs) and:
#’   1. Rarefies it n_iterations times to a given sequence_depth
#’   2. Computes richness (specnumber) and Shannon diversity (diversity) on each rarefied table
#’   3. Averages the results across all iterations
#’
#’ @param otu_table         A matrix or data.frame of counts (rows = samples, columns = OTUs).
#’ @param n_iterations      Number of rarefaction iterations (default = 100).
#’ @param sequence_depth    Depth to rarefy to (default = 1900).
#’ @param set_seed          Optional integer seed for reproducibility (default = NULL).
#’ @return A data.frame with one row per sample and two columns: 
#’         “Richness” (average S) and “Shannon” (average Shannon index).
#’ @examples
#’ # Suppose your raw OTU table is called “curto_unrar_otutab”:
#’ result_df <- calc_alpha_diversity(curto_unrar_otutab, 
#’                                   n_iterations = 100, 
#’                                   sequence_depth = 1900, 
#’                                   set_seed = 711)
#’ head(result_df)
#’
calc_alpha_diversity <- function(otu_table, 
                                 n_iterations    = 100, 
                                 sequence_depth  = 1900, 
                                 set_seed        = NULL) {
  # Load required package
  if (!requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'vegan' is required but not installed.")
  }
  
  # Optionally set a seed
  if (!is.null(set_seed)) {
    set.seed(set_seed)
  }
  
  # Ensure otu_table is in matrix form
  otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_table)
  
  # Create empty lists to store each iteration’s results
  alpha_list <- vector("list", n_iterations)
  S_list     <- vector("list", n_iterations)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_iterations)) {
    # Print progress
    cat("Iteration", i, "of", n_iterations, "\n")
    
    # 1) Rarefy to 'sequence_depth'
    rarified <- vegan::rrarefy(otu_mat, sample = sequence_depth)
    
    # 2) Compute Shannon diversity (vegan::diversity) for each sample
    #    This returns a numeric vector of length = nrow(rarified)
    shannon_vec <- vegan::diversity(rarified, index = "shannon")
    alpha_list[[i]] <- shannon_vec
    
    # 3) Compute richness (number of observed OTUs) for each sample
    richness_vec <- vegan::specnumber(rarified)
    S_list[[i]] <- richness_vec
    
    # Clean up
    rm(rarified, shannon_vec, richness_vec)
  }
  
  # Combine all iterations column‐wise: each iteration is one column
  alpha_matrix <- do.call(cbind, alpha_list)
  S_matrix     <- do.call(cbind, S_list)
  
  # Average across iterations (rowMeans); for richness we’ll round to integer
  avg_shannon <- rowMeans(alpha_matrix)
  avg_S       <- round(rowMeans(S_matrix))
  
  # Build final data.frame
  output_df <- data.frame(
    Richness = avg_S,
    Shannon  = avg_shannon,
    row.names = rownames(otu_mat)
  )
  
  return(output_df)
}

  n_iterations   = 100,
  sequence_depth = 165,

)
```

##### PERMANOVAS

- At each site:
  - Test for the effect of substrate (litter) and inoculum and interaction
  
- Across sites:
  - Effect of climate in cases that the combination of substrate and inoculum matches across loma and the comparing site
    - these are:
      - I-LOMA on S-LOMA
      - I-LOMA on S-away
      - I-away on S-away

```{r PERMANOVAS, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(purrr)

reserves <- sort(unique(metadata$reserve_code))
reserves <- reserves[-5]


# run one PERMANOVA per reserve
permanova_by_reserve <- map(reserves, function(res) {
  # 1. subset metadata
  test <- metadata %>%
    filter(reserve_code == res,
           Bag_type     == "Closed",
           i_code       != "none")
  
  # 2. get sample names
  samples <- sort(unique(test$original_label))
  
  # 3. subset the distance matrix
  dm_full <- as.matrix(mg_subclds_distmat)
  dm_sub  <- dm_full[samples, samples]
  d_sub   <- as.dist(dm_sub)
  
  # 4. run the PERMANOVA
  ad <- adonis2(d_sub ~  s_code * i_code,
                data        = test,
                by           = "terms",
                permutations = 999)
  
  ## 5. now also generate the output tables for each reserve for PRIMER
  
  # 5a. file name
  out_file <- paste0("dm_", res, ".csv")
  
  # 5b. write distance matrix
  write.csv(dm_sub,
              file = out_file,
              row.names = T,
              quote = F)
  
   # 5c. single blank line
   cat("\n", file = out_file, append = TRUE)
  
   # 5d. two‐row metadata block
  md_mat <- test %>%
    dplyr::select(s_code, i_code) %>%
    t()
  # append metadata
  write.table(
    md_mat,
    file      = out_file,
    sep       = ",",
    quote     = FALSE,
    row.names = TRUE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    append    = TRUE
  )
  # return it
  ad
  
})
```

###### Pairs for PRIMER

```{r pair logic for primer}

add_pair_label <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(pair = case_when(
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code == "LOMA" ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA" ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      reserve_code == "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA" ~ paste(i_code,      "vs", "LOMA"),
      TRUE                                      ~ paste(s_code,      "vs", "LOMA")
    ))
}


# choose the one pair you want to test
target_pair <- "BLOK vs LOMA"   # <- change this

# mirror your analysis filters
meta_ext <- metadata %>%
  filter(Bag_type != "Open", i_code != "none") %>%
  add_pair_label()


# 1. Identify your “other” reserves
others <- meta_ext %>%
  pull(reserve_code) %>%
  unique() %>%
  setdiff("LOMA")

# 2. Extract the LOMA‐vs‐LOMA rows
lomavs <- meta_ext %>%
  filter(i_code == "LOMA" & pair == "LOMA vs LOMA")

# 3. Cross‐join to each other reserve and rewrite pair
new_rows <- lomavs %>%
  crossing(other = others) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(other, "vs LOMA")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-other)

# 4. Bind back
meta_ext <- bind_rows(meta_ext, new_rows)


# mirror your analysis filters
meta_one <- metadata %>%
  filter(Bag_type != "Open", i_code != "none") %>%
  add_pair_label()



# samples that belong to that pair context
rows <- which(meta_one$pair == target_pair)

# (optional) include LOMA–LOMA samples on LOMA side in every pair
rows <- union(
  rows,
  which(meta_one$reserve_code == "LOMA" &
        meta_one$s_code      == "LOMA" &
        meta_one$i_code      == "LOMA")
)

stopifnot(length(rows) > 0)


# make sure the full DM uses sample IDs present in metadata (same order not required)
ids_all <- meta_one$original_label
D_full  <- as.matrix(mg_subclds_distmat)[ids_all, ids_all, drop = FALSE]

# now subset to the rows for this pair
D_sub   <- D_full[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]

    filter(pair == current_pair,

  # 3. subset the distance matrix
  dm_full <- as.matrix(mg_subclds_distmat)
  dm_sub  <- dm_full[samples, samples]
  d_sub   <- as.dist(dm_sub)
  
  # 4. run the PERMANOVA
  ad <- adonis2(d_sub ~  reserve_code * s_code * i_code,
                data        = test,
                by           = "terms",
                permutations = 999)
  
  ## 5. now also generate the output tables for each reserve for PRIMER
  
  # 5a. file name
  out_file <- paste0("dm_", current_pair, ".csv")
  
  # 5b. write distance matrix
  write.csv(dm_sub,
              file = out_file,
              row.names = T,
              quote = F)
  
   # 5c. single blank line

  # append metadata
```

##### calculating centroids ###

```{r centroids, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

library(purrr)

# comm: samples x taxa *counts* (rownames = sample IDs in meta[[id_col]])
# meta: data.frame with id_col and your grouping columns
# group_cols define a "treatment cell" (e.g., reserve_code, s_code, i_code, Bag_type)
centroid_dm_rarefy <- function(
  comm, meta,
  id_col      = "original_label",
  group_cols  = c("reserve_code","s_code","i_code","Bag_type"),
  depth       = NULL,
  iterations  = 100,
  method      = "bray",
  seed        = NULL,
  sep         = " | ",
  return_centroids = TRUE
){
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  ## Align rows
  meta2 <- meta[, c(id_col, group_cols), drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(all(meta2[[id_col]] %in% rownames(comm)))
  comm2 <- comm[ meta2[[id_col]], , drop = FALSE ]

  ## Rarefaction depth
  libs <- rowSums(comm2)
  if (is.null(depth)) depth <- min(libs)
  if (depth <= 0) stop("Depth must be > 0.")

  ## Group id (treatment cell) and counts per cell
  grp <- interaction(meta2[, group_cols], drop = TRUE, sep = sep)
  n_per_group <- as.integer(table(grp))
  names(n_per_group) <- names(table(grp))

  ## One iteration → DM (and centroids if requested)
  one_iter <- function() {
    # rarefy each replicate to 'depth'
    comm_r <- vegan::rrarefy(comm2, sample = depth)
    # Bray–Curtis is invariant to a common total; using counts is fine here.
    # If you prefer, uncomment the next two lines to use relative abundance:
    # comm_r <- sweep(comm_r, 1, pmax(rowSums(comm_r), 1), "/")

    # centroid per group = mean rarefied profile
    C <- rowsum(comm_r, grp)
    C <- C / as.vector(table(grp))
    if (ncol(C) > 1) C <- C[, colSums(C) > 0, drop = FALSE]

    list(C = C, D = as.matrix(vegan::vegdist(C, method = method)))
  }

  iters <- purrr::map(seq_len(iterations), ~ one_iter())

  ## Align & average distance matrices
  all_names <- Reduce(union, lapply(iters, function(x) rownames(x$D)))
  align_D <- function(M) {
    M2 <- matrix(NA_real_, length(all_names), length(all_names),
                 dimnames = list(all_names, all_names))
    rn <- rownames(M); cn <- colnames(M)
    M2[rn, cn] <- M
    M2
  }
  Ds <- lapply(iters, function(x) align_D(x$D))
  num   <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(Ds, function(x){ x[is.na(x)] <- 0; x }))
  denom <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(Ds, function(x) !is.na(x)))
  Davg  <- num / denom

  out <- list(dist_mat = Davg, depth = depth, labels = all_names, sep = sep,
              n_per_group = n_per_group)

  ## (optional) also average centroids across iterations
  if (return_centroids) {
    all_taxa <- Reduce(union, lapply(iters, function(x) colnames(x$C)))
    align_C <- function(C) {
      C2 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(all_names), ncol = length(all_taxa),
                   dimnames = list(all_names, all_taxa))
      C2[rownames(C), colnames(C)] <- C
      C2
    }
    Cs <- lapply(iters, function(x) align_C(x$C))
    Cnum   <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(Cs, function(x){ x[is.na(x)] <- 0; x }))
    Cdenom <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(Cs, function(x) !is.na(x)))
    Cavg   <- Cnum / Cdenom
    out$centroids_avg <- Cavg
    out$taxa          <- colnames(Cavg)
  }

  out
}

extract_loma_pairs <- function(
  res,
  group_cols = c("reserve_code","s_code","i_code","Bag_type"),
  loma       = "LOMA",
  sep        = " | "
){
  stopifnot(length(group_cols) >= 2)
  M    <- res$dist_mat
  labs <- rownames(M)
  if (is.null(labs) || !identical(labs, colnames(M))) {
    stop("dist_mat must have identical row/col names.")
  }

  # Split labels into a fixed number of columns (no regex interpretation)
  parts <- stringr::str_split_fixed(labs, stringr::fixed(sep), n = length(group_cols))
  colnames(parts) <- group_cols

  idx <- tibble::tibble(row = labs, !!!as.data.frame(parts))

  reserve_col   <- group_cols[1]
  scenario_cols <- group_cols[-1]

  # Keep only rows where reserve == LOMA and reserve != LOMA for pairing
  away  <- dplyr::filter(idx, .data[[reserve_col]] != loma)
  home  <- dplyr::filter(idx, .data[[reserve_col]] == loma)

  # Pair by identical scenario values; drop scenarios not present on both sides
  paired <- dplyr::inner_join(
    away, home, by = scenario_cols, suffix = c("_R", "_LOMA")
  )

  # Pull distances for each paired scenario: M[row_R, row_LOMA]
  tibble::tibble(
    reserve   = paired[[paste0(reserve_col, "_R")]],
    !!!rlang::set_names(paired[scenario_cols], scenario_cols),
    comp_dist = M[cbind(paired$row_R, paired$row_LOMA)]
  )
}

    X <- as.matrix(df[match(c("LOMA", away), df$reserve_code), taxa_cols, drop = FALSE])
    tibble::tibble(
      pair      = df$pair[1],
      away_res  = away,
      comp_dist = as.numeric(vegan::vegdist(X, method = "bray"))
    )
  })
```

### community distances 

```{r avg. community distances}
avg_block_dists_plus <- function(D, groups) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(D), isTRUE(all(rownames(D) == colnames(D))),
            length(groups) == nrow(D))
  lev <- levels(factor(groups)); G <- length(lev)

  between       <- matrix(NA_real_, G, G, dimnames = list(lev, lev))
  pairs_between <- matrix(0L,       G, G, dimnames = list(lev, lev))
  within        <- rep(NA_real_,    G); names(within) <- lev
  pairs_within  <- rep(0L,          G); names(pairs_within) <- lev
  n_in          <- setNames(integer(G), lev)

  for (i in seq_len(G)) {
    Ii <- which(groups == lev[i]); n_in[i] <- length(Ii)
    if (n_in[i] >= 2) {
      m <- D[Ii, Ii, drop = FALSE]
      within[i]       <- mean(m[upper.tri(m)], na.rm = TRUE)
      pairs_within[i] <- choose(n_in[i], 2)
    }
    for (j in i:G) {
      Jj <- which(groups == lev[j])
      if (i == j) {
        between[i,i]       <- within[i]
        pairs_between[i,i] <- pairs_within[i]
      } else {
        between[i,j]       <- between[j,i]       <- mean(D[Ii, Jj], na.rm = TRUE)
        pairs_between[i,j] <- pairs_between[j,i] <- length(Ii) * length(Jj)
      }
    }
  }
  list(between = between, within = within, n = n_in,
       pairs_between = pairs_between, pairs_within = pairs_within)
}

    mean_within_away = res$between[away_res, away_res],
    pairs_between    = res$pairs_between["LOMA", away_res],
    pairs_within_LOMA= res$pairs_within["LOMA"],
    pairs_within_away= res$pairs_within[away_res]
  )
})

  distinct(pair, comp_id, t1, t2)

calculate_comp_dists <- function(distance_matrix, membership, pairs = NULL, comp_ids = NULL, min_n = 1) {
  D_full <- as.matrix(distance_matrix)
  stopifnot(is.matrix(D_full), is.character(rownames(D_full)))

  mem <- membership %>%
    filter(grp %in% c("A","B")) %>%
    mutate(grp = factor(grp, levels = c("A","B")))

  # optional subsetting
  if (!is.null(pairs))    mem <- mem %>% filter(pair %in% pairs)
  if (!is.null(comp_ids)) mem <- mem %>% filter(comp_id %in% comp_ids)

  # comp labels lookup (t1,t2 per pair/comp), if available via i_r_l
  comp_lookup <- mem %>%
    distinct(pair, comp_id, grp, i_r_l) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = grp, values_from = i_r_l, names_prefix = "t") %>%
    rename(t1 = tA, t2 = tB)

  # iterate over pair × comp_id
  keys <- mem %>% distinct(pair, comp_id) %>% arrange(pair, comp_id)

  results <- pmap_dfr(keys, function(pair, comp_id) {
    subm <- mem %>% filter(pair == !!pair, comp_id == !!comp_id)

    # rows in DM
    ids <- subm$original_label
    ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(D_full))
    if (length(ids) < 2) return(tibble())

    Dp  <- D_full[ids, ids, drop = FALSE]
    grp <- subm$grp[match(ids, subm$original_label)]
    grp <- factor(grp, levels = c("A","B"))

    # require both arms and min_n per arm
    nA <- sum(grp == "A"); nB <- sum(grp == "B")
    if (nA < min_n || nB < min_n) return(tibble())

    res <- avg_block_dists_plus(Dp, grp)

    tibble(
      pair,
      comp_id,
      t1 = comp_lookup$t1[comp_lookup$pair == pair & comp_lookup$comp_id == comp_id],
      t2 = comp_lookup$t2[comp_lookup$pair == pair & comp_lookup$comp_id == comp_id],
      n_A = as.integer(res$n["A"]),
      n_B = as.integer(res$n["B"]),
      mean_between   = res$between["A","B"],
      mean_within_A  = res$between["A","A"],
      mean_within_B  = res$between["B","B"],
      pairs_between  = as.integer(res$pairs_between["A","B"]),
      pairs_within_A = as.integer(res$pairs_within["A"]),
      pairs_within_B = as.integer(res$pairs_within["B"])
    )
  })

  results %>% arrange(pair, comp_id)
}

###### Calculating euclidean distnaces as a matric for convergence



#’ Calculate eculidean distances via repeated rarefaction ####
#’
#’ This function takes an unrarefied OTU table (samples × OTUs) and:
#’   1. Rarefies it n_iterations times to a given sequence_depth
#’   2. Computes eculiedan distances among all samples
#’   3. Averages the results across all iterations
#’
#’ @param otu_table         A matrix or data.frame of counts (rows = samples, columns = OTUs).
#’ @param n_iterations      Number of rarefaction iterations (default = 100).
#’ @param sequence_depth    Depth to rarefy to (default = 1900).
#’ @param set_seed          Optional integer seed for reproducibility (default = NULL).
#’ @return A euclidean distance matrix: 
#’     
#’ @examples
#’ # Suppose your raw OTU table is called “curto_unrar_otutab”:
#’ result_df <- calc_rarefaction_euclidean(curto_unrar_otutab, 
#’                                   n_iterations = 100, 
#’                                   sequence_depth = 1900, 
#’                                   set_seed = 711)
#’ head(result_df)
#’
calc_rarefaction_euclidean <- function(otu_table, 
                                 n_iterations    = 100, 
                                 sequence_depth  = 1900, 
                                 set_seed        = NULL) {
  # Load required package
  if (!requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'vegan' is required but not installed.")
  }
  
  # Optionally set a seed
  if (!is.null(set_seed)) {
    set.seed(set_seed)
  }
  
  # Ensure otu_table is in matrix form
  otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_table)
  
  # Create empty lists to store each iteration’s results
  euclidean_list <- vector("list", n_iterations)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_iterations)) {
    # Print progress
    cat("Iteration", i, "of", n_iterations, "\n")
    
    # 1) Rarefy to 'sequence_depth'
    rarified <- suppressWarnings(vegan::rrarefy(otu_mat, sample = sequence_depth))
    
    # 2) Compute euclidean distance for rarified OTU table
    #    This returns a numeric vector of length = nrow(rarified)
    euc_mat <- dist(rarified, method = "euclidean")
    euclidean_list[[i]] <- as.matrix(euc_mat)
    
    # Clean up
    rm(rarified, euc_mat)
  }
  
 # 3) Average all distance matrices element-wise
  #    Stack into a 3D array (samples × samples × iterations), then take the mean
  euc_array  <- array(unlist(euclidean_list),
                      dim = c(nrow(otu_mat), nrow(otu_mat), n_iterations))
  avg_matrix <- apply(euc_array, c(1, 2), mean)
  
  # Restore row/column names
  rownames(avg_matrix) <- rownames(otu_mat)
  colnames(avg_matrix) <- rownames(otu_mat)
  
  # 4) Convert back to a dist object
  avg_dist <- as.dist(avg_matrix)
  
  return(avg_dist)
}

get_ids <- function(lookup, p, lab) {
  idx <- which(lookup$pair == p & lookup$i_r_l == lab)
  if (length(idx) == 0) character(0) else unlist(lookup$ids[idx], use.names = FALSE)
}

mean_cross <- function(D, I, J) {
  I <- intersect(I, rownames(D)); J <- intersect(J, rownames(D))
  if (length(I) == 0 || length(J) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(D[I, J, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}

mean_within <- function(D, I) {
  I <- intersect(I, rownames(D)); if (length(I) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  M <- D[I, I, drop = FALSE]; mean(M[upper.tri(M)], na.rm = TRUE)
}

build_pair_lookup <- function(meta_ext) {
  meta_ext %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pair, i_r_l) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(ids = list(original_label), .groups = "drop")
}



compute_path <- function(
  D_full, lookup, path_name, path_steps,
  R0_label = "away|away & non-LOMA",
  zero_R_within = FALSE,
  zero_R0_within = FALSE
) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(D_full), isTRUE(all(rownames(D_full) == colnames(D_full))))
  stopifnot(length(path_steps) == 3)

  S0 <- path_steps[1]
  S1 <- path_steps[2]
  R  <- path_steps[3]
  pairs <- sort(unique(lookup$pair))

  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
    ids_S0 <- get_ids(lookup, p, S0)
    ids_S1 <- get_ids(lookup, p, S1)
    ids_R  <- get_ids(lookup, p, R)
    ids_R0 <- get_ids(lookup, p, R0_label)

    # require all sets to exist
    if (length(ids_S0) == 0 || length(ids_S1) == 0 || length(ids_R) == 0 || length(ids_R0) == 0) {
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }

    # ---------- R-anchored metrics ----------
    dS0_R <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S0, ids_R)
    dS1_R <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S1, ids_R)
    dR_R  <- if (zero_R_within) 0 else mean_within(D_full, ids_R)

    D_S0_S1 <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S0, ids_S1)
    D_S1_R  <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S1, ids_R)

    delta1 <- dS0_R - dS1_R
    delta2 <- dS1_R - dR_R

    eta1 <- if (is.na(D_S0_S1) || D_S0_S1 == 0) NA_real_ else delta1 / D_S0_S1
    eta2 <- if (is.na(D_S1_R)  || D_S1_R  == 0) NA_real_ else delta2 / D_S1_R
    
    F_s1 <- if (is.na(dS0_R)  || dS0_R  == 0) NA_real_ else 1 - (dS1_R/dS0_R)

    # ---------- R0-anchored metrics ----------
    dS0_R0 <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S0, ids_R0)
    dS1_R0 <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S1, ids_R0)
    dR_R0  <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_R,  ids_R0)
    dR0_R0 <- if (zero_R0_within) 0 else mean_within(D_full, ids_R0)

    D_S1_R0 <- mean_cross(D_full, ids_S1, ids_R0)

    delta1_R0 <- dS0_R0 - dS1_R0
    delta2_R0 <- dS1_R0 - dR_R0
    total_delta_R0 <- dS0_R0 - dR_R0

    eta1_R0 <- if (is.na(D_S0_S1) || D_S0_S1 == 0) NA_real_ else delta1_R0 / D_S0_S1
    eta2_R0 <- if (is.na(D_S1_R0) || D_S1_R0 == 0) NA_real_ else delta2_R0 / D_S1_R0
    
    F_s1_R0 <- if (is.na(dS0_R0)  || dS0_R0  == 0) NA_real_ else 1 - (dS1_R0/dS0_R0)
      
    # fraction of native shift achieved
    # 1 = endpoint equals native away target
    # 0 = endpoint no closer to R0 than S0 was
    # <0 = endpoint farther from R0 than S0
    native_shift_frac <- if (is.na(dS0_R0) || dS0_R0 == 0) NA_real_ else 1 - (dR_R0 / dS0_R0)

    tibble::tibble(
      pair = p,
      path = path_name,
      S0 = S0, S1 = S1, R = R, R0 = R0_label,

      n_S0 = length(ids_S0),
      n_S1 = length(ids_S1),
      n_R  = length(ids_R),
      n_R0 = length(ids_R0),

      # R-anchored
      d_to_R_S0 = dS0_R,
      d_to_R_S1 = dS1_R,
      d_to_R_R  = dR_R,
      delta1 = delta1,
      delta2 = delta2,
      total_delta = dS0_R - dR_R,
      D_S0_S1 = D_S0_S1,
      D_S1_R  = D_S1_R,
      eta1 = eta1,
      eta2 = eta2,
      F_s1 = F_s1,

      # R0-anchored
      d_to_R0_S0 = dS0_R0,
      d_to_R0_S1 = dS1_R0,
      d_to_R0_R  = dR_R0,
      d_to_R0_R0 = dR0_R0,
      delta1_R0 = delta1_R0,
      delta2_R0 = delta2_R0,
      total_delta_R0 = total_delta_R0,
      D_S1_R0 = D_S1_R0,
      eta1_R0 = eta1_R0,
      eta2_R0 = eta2_R0,
      F_s1_R0 = F_s1_R0,

      # endpoint quality
      dR_R0 = dR_R0,
      native_shift_frac = native_shift_frac
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(pair, path)
}


compute_all_paths <- function(
  D_full, meta_ext,
  R0_label = "away|away & non-LOMA",
  zero_R_within = FALSE,
  zero_R0_within = FALSE
) {
  lookup <- build_pair_lookup(meta_ext)

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    compute_path(D_full, lookup, "LOMA_clim_eff", paths$LOMA_clim_eff,
                 R0_label = R0_label,
                 zero_R_within = zero_R_within,
                 zero_R0_within = zero_R0_within),

    compute_path(D_full, lookup, "LOMA_litt_eff", paths$LOMA_litt_eff,
                 R0_label = R0_label,
                 zero_R_within = zero_R_within,
                 zero_R0_within = zero_R0_within),

    compute_path(D_full, lookup, "LOMA_int_eff", paths$LOMA_int_eff,
                 R0_label = R0_label,
                 zero_R_within = zero_R_within,
                 zero_R0_within = zero_R0_within),

    compute_path(D_full, lookup, "away_clim_eff", paths$away_clim_eff,
                 R0_label = "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
                 zero_R_within = zero_R_within,
                 zero_R0_within = zero_R0_within),

    compute_path(D_full, lookup, "away_litt_eff", paths$away_litt_eff,
                 R0_label = "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
                 zero_R_within = zero_R_within,
                 zero_R0_within = zero_R0_within)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(pair)
}

check_paths <- function(lookup, paths) {
  need <- tibble::tibble(pair = unique(lookup$pair)) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(label = unlist(paths, use.names = FALSE)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(has = purrr::pmap_lgl(list(pair, label),
      ~ any(lookup$pair == ..1 & lookup$i_r_l == ..2)))
  dplyr::filter(need, !has) %>% dplyr::arrange(pair, label)
}

#### additional analysis

# helper: safe pull ids for (pair, label)
get_ids <- function(lookup, p, lab) {
  idx <- which(lookup$pair == p & lookup$i_r_l == lab)
  if (length(idx) == 0) character(0) else unlist(lookup$ids[idx], use.names = FALSE)
}

# explode paths_df to sample-level rows: one row per sample at each step
step_long <- paths_df %>%
  select(pair, path, S0, S1, R) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(S0,S1,R), names_to = "step", values_to = "label") %>%
  mutate(step_index = recode(step, S0 = 0L, S1 = 1L, R = 2L)) %>%
  arrange(pair, path, step_index) %>%
  mutate(sample_ids = pmap(
    list(pair, label),
    ~ get_ids(lookup, ..1, ..2)
  )) %>%
  unnest_longer(sample_ids, values_to = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_id))

# fast within-group mean of upper triangle
mean_within <- function(D, ids) {
  ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(D))
  if (length(ids) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  M <- D[ids, ids, drop = FALSE]
  mean(M[upper.tri(M)], na.rm = TRUE)
}

D <- as.matrix(D_full)

mpd_step <- step_long %>%
  group_by(pair, path, step_index) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mpd = mean_within(D, sample_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


trend_stats <- mpd_step %>%
  #filter(step_index != 2) |>
  group_by(pair, path) %>%
  reframe(
    slope = coef(lm(mpd ~ step_index))[2],
    rho   = suppressWarnings(cor(step_index, mpd, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
    n0 = n[step_index==0], n1 = n[step_index==1], n2 = n[step_index==2]#,
    #.groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(mpd_step |> filter(step_index != 2),
       aes(step_index, mpd, group = interaction(pair, path), colour = path)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2, labels = c("S0","S1","R")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(LOMA_clim_eff = "#023903",
                                LOMA_litt_eff = "#38913A",
                                LOMA_int_eff = "#98C698",
                                away_clim_eff = "#AC64B9",
                                away_litt_eff = "#D5ADDD")) +
  labs(x = "Step", y = "Mean pairwise Bray–Curtis (within step)") +
  facet_wrap(~ pair, ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r avg. community distances genus level}
# helper: safe pull ids for (pair, label)
get_ids <- function(lookup, p, lab) {
  idx <- which(lookup$pair == p & lookup$i_r_l == lab)
  if (length(idx) == 0) character(0) else unlist(lookup$ids[idx], use.names = FALSE)
}

# explode paths_df to sample-level rows: one row per sample at each step
step_long_genus <- paths_df_genus %>%
  select(pair, path, S0, S1, R) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(S0,S1,R), names_to = "step", values_to = "label") %>%
  mutate(step_index = recode(step, S0 = 0L, S1 = 1L, R = 2L)) %>%
  arrange(pair, path, step_index) %>%
  mutate(sample_ids = pmap(
    list(pair, label),
    ~ get_ids(lookup, ..1, ..2)
  )) %>%
  unnest_longer(sample_ids, values_to = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_id))

# fast within-group mean of upper triangle
mean_within <- function(D, ids) {
  ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(D))
  if (length(ids) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  M <- D[ids, ids, drop = FALSE]
  mean(M[upper.tri(M)], na.rm = TRUE)
}


D <- as.matrix(mg_genus_distmat)

mpd_step_genus <- step_long_genus %>%
  group_by(pair, path, step_index) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mpd = mean_within(D, sample_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


trend_stats_genus <- mpd_step %>%
  #filter(step_index != 2) |>
  group_by(pair, path) %>%
  reframe(
    slope = coef(lm(mpd ~ step_index))[2],
    rho   = suppressWarnings(cor(step_index, mpd, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
    n0 = n[step_index==0], n1 = n[step_index==1], n2 = n[step_index==2]#,
    #.groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(mpd_step_genus |> filter(step_index != 2),
       aes(step_index, mpd, group = interaction(pair, path), colour = path)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2, labels = c("S0","S1","R")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(LOMA_clim_eff = "#023903",
                                LOMA_litt_eff = "#38913A",
                                LOMA_int_eff = "#98C698",
                                away_clim_eff = "#AC64B9",
                                away_litt_eff = "#D5ADDD")) +
  labs(x = "Step", y = "Mean pairwise Bray–Curtis (within step)") +
  facet_wrap(~ pair, ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r beta div, echo=FALSE, fig.height=20, fig.width=25, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
subclades_nmds_df <- subclades_nmds_df |>
  mutate(pair = case_when(
      # if the focal site is LOMA, name it “LOMA vs <other>”
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code == "LOMA"  ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      # if the inoculum is LOMA, also name it “LOMA vs <other reserve>”
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      # otherwise fall back to the regular “A vs B”
      reserve_code == "LOMA" & !i_code  %in%  c("LOMA", "none")  ~ paste(i_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      TRUE                         ~ paste(s_code, "vs", "LOMA")
  ))


# 1. Identify your “other” reserves
others <- subclades_nmds_df %>%
  pull(reserve_code) %>%
  unique() %>%
  setdiff("LOMA")

# 2. Extract the LOMA‐vs‐LOMA rows
lomavs <- subclades_nmds_df %>%
  filter(pair == "LOMA vs LOMA")

# 3. Cross‐join to each other reserve and rewrite pair
new_rows <- lomavs %>%
  crossing(other = others) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(other, "vs LOMA")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-other)

# 4. Bind back

expanded_df <- expanded_df %>%
  mutate(treatment3 = paste(treatment_2, pair, sep = "|"))

expanded_df_centroids <- expanded_df  |> 
  dplyr::group_by(treatment3) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(meanMDS1 = mean(MDS1),
                   meanMDS2 = mean(MDS2),
                   sdMDS1 = sd(MDS1),
                   sdMDS2 = sd(MDS2),
                   seMDS1 = sd(MDS1) / sqrt(n()),
                   seMDS2 = sd(MDS2) / sqrt(n())) |> 
  left_join(expanded_df, by = "treatment3") |> 
  distinct(treatment3, .keep_all = T) |>
  mutate(reserve_litter = case_when(reserve_code == "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & LOMA",
                                    reserve_code == "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & non-LOMA",
                                    reserve_code != "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "away & LOMA",
                                    reserve_code != "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "away & non-LOMA"),
         inoc_litter = case_when(i_code == "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & LOMA",
                                 i_code == "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & non-LOMA",
                                 i_code != "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "away & LOMA",
                                 i_code != "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "away & non-LOMA"),
         i_r_l = case_when(i_code == "LOMA" ~ paste(i_code, reserve_litter, sep = "|"),
                           i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste("away", reserve_litter, sep = "|")))


# define the three trajectories in terms of i_r_l labels
plot_paths <- tribble(
 ~source, ~path, ~step, ~i_r_l,
  "LOMA", "Climate",      0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Climate",      1L,    "LOMA|away & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Climate",      2L,    "away|away & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       1L,    "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       2L,    "away|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  1L,    "LOMA|away & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  2L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      1L,    "away|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      2L,    "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       1L,    "away|away & LOMA",

)

  select(pair, i_code, reserve_litter, inoc_litter, Bag_type, i_r_l,

# build the path table for plotting (drop incomplete paths per pair)

  group_by(pair, path) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(step) == 3) %>%       # keep only pairs with all three steps
  arrange(step, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

pairs <- sort(unique(subclades_nmds_df$pair))[-c(5,8)]

# 1. Create an empty list, named by your pairs
plot_list <- vector("list", length(pairs))
names(plot_list) <- pairs

for (target_pair in pairs){
  
  subset_df <- subclades_nmds_df |> filter(i_code != "none",
                                   pair %in% c(target_pair, "LOMA vs LOMA"))%>%
  mutate(
    # if the substrate reserve matches the sample’s reserve → fill with reserve_code
    fill_home = if_else(s_code == i_code,
                                 s_code,
                                 NA_character_)
  )
  
  subset_res <- strsplit(target_pair, " ")[[1]][1]
  
  shape_vals <- setNames(c(21, 24), c(subset_res, "LOMA"))
  
    # enforce the same two‐level order everywhere
  res_levels <- c(subset_res, "LOMA")
  inoc_levels <- c(subset_res, "LOMA")  # or c("BLOK","LOMA") if that’s all you ever have

  
  subset_plot <- subset_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2,
              shape = reserve_code,
              color = i_code,
              fill = fill_home)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      name   = "Inoculum",
      values = inoc_colors,
      breaks = inoc_levels,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2,
                           title.position="top",
                           direction="horizontal")
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = "Reserve",
                       breaks = res_levels,
                       guide = guide_legend(order = 1,
                                            title.position="top",
                                            direction="horizontal")) +
    # 2) Fill for substrate‐home, transparent if away
  scale_fill_manual(
    name     = "Litter = home",
    values   = reserve_colors,
    na.value = NA,   # away = open
    breaks   = c(subset_res, NA),
    labels = c("home", "away"),
    guide    = guide_legend(
      order = 3,
      title.position="top",
      direction="horizontal",
      override.aes = list(
      shape  = c(15, 0),         # show both circle & triangle
      colour = "black",          # black border for legend keys
      size   = 1.5,
      stroke = 0.5
    ))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.4,0.4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.4,0.4)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
          legend.box         = "horizontal",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 5,
                                      hjust = 0.5,
                                      margin = margin(b = 0.4)),
          legend.key.size    = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.x   = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.y   = unit(0.1,   "cm"),
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
          legend.margin      = margin(t = 0.25, r = 0.2, b = 0.1, l = 0.2),
          legend.text        = element_text(size = 4,
                              margin = margin(l = 1, unit = "pt")),
          text = element_text(size = 4)) +
    labs(title = target_pair)
  
  print(subset_plot)
  # store it
  plot_list[[target_pair]] <- subset_plot
}
```

```{r genus NMDS}
genus_nmds_df <- genus_nmds_df |>
  mutate(pair = case_when(
      # if the focal site is LOMA, name it “LOMA vs <other>”
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code == "LOMA"  ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      # if the inoculum is LOMA, also name it “LOMA vs <other reserve>”
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      # otherwise fall back to the regular “A vs B”
      reserve_code == "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste(i_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      TRUE                         ~ paste(s_code, "vs", "LOMA")
  ))


# 1. Identify your “other” reserves
others <- genus_nmds_df %>%
  pull(reserve_code) %>%
  unique() %>%
  setdiff("LOMA")

# 2. Extract the LOMA‐vs‐LOMA rows
lomavs <- genus_nmds_df %>%
  filter(i_code == "LOMA" & pair == "LOMA vs LOMA")

# 3. Cross‐join to each other reserve and rewrite pair
new_rows <- lomavs %>%
  crossing(other = others) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(other, "vs LOMA")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-other)

# 4. Bind back
genus_expanded_df <- bind_rows(genus_nmds_df, new_rows)

genus_expanded_df_centroids <- genus_expanded_df  |> 
  dplyr::group_by(treatment3) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(meanMDS1 = mean(MDS1),
                   meanMDS2 = mean(MDS2),
                   sdMDS1 = sd(MDS1),
                   sdMDS2 = sd(MDS2),
                   seMDS1 = sd(MDS1) / sqrt(n()),
                   seMDS2 = sd(MDS2) / sqrt(n())) |> 
  left_join(genus_expanded_df, by = "treatment3") |> 
  distinct(treatment3, .keep_all = T) |>
  mutate(reserve_litter = case_when(reserve_code == "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & LOMA",
                                    reserve_code == "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & non-LOMA",
                                    reserve_code != "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "away & LOMA",
                                    reserve_code != "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "away & non-LOMA"),
         inoc_litter = case_when(i_code == "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & LOMA",
                                 i_code == "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & non-LOMA",
                                 i_code != "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "away & LOMA",
                                 i_code != "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "away & non-LOMA"),
         i_r_l = case_when(i_code == "LOMA" ~ paste(i_code, reserve_litter, sep = "|"),
                           i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste("away", reserve_litter, sep = "|")))


# define the three trajectories in terms of i_r_l labels
plot_paths <- tribble(
 ~source, ~path, ~step, ~i_r_l,
  "LOMA", "Climate",      0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Climate",      1L,    "LOMA|away & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Climate",      2L,    "away|away & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       1L,    "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       2L,    "away|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  1L,    "LOMA|away & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  2L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      1L,    "away|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      2L,    "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       1L,    "away|away & LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       2L,    "LOMA|away & LOMA"
)


plot_paths_away <- tribble(
  ~path, ~step, ~i_r_l,
  "Climate",      0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "Climate",      1L,    "away|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "Climate",      2L,    "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "Litter",       0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "Litter",       1L,    "away|away & LOMA",
  "Litter",       2L,    "LOMA|away & LOMA"
)

# attach i_r_l to your centroids (you already computed it)
cent_genus <- genus_expanded_df_centroids %>%
  select(pair, i_code, reserve_litter, inoc_litter, i_r_l,
         meanMDS1, meanMDS2, seMDS1, seMDS2)

# build the path table for plotting (drop incomplete paths per pair)
cent_paths_genus <- cent_genus %>%
  inner_join(plot_paths, by = "i_r_l") %>%
  group_by(pair, path) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(step) == 3) %>%       # keep only pairs with all three steps
  arrange(step, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

pairs <- sort(unique(genus_nmds_df$pair))[-c(5,8)]

# 1. Create an empty list, named by your pairs
plot_list <- vector("list", length(pairs))
names(plot_list) <- pairs

for (target_pair in pairs){
  
  subset_df <- genus_nmds_df |> filter(i_code != "none",
                                   pair %in% c(target_pair, "LOMA vs LOMA"))%>%
  mutate(
    # if the substrate reserve matches the sample’s reserve → fill with reserve_code
    fill_home = if_else(s_code == i_code,
                                 s_code,
                                 NA_character_)
  )
  
  subset_res <- strsplit(target_pair, " ")[[1]][1]
  
  shape_vals <- setNames(c(21, 24), c(subset_res, "LOMA"))
  
    # enforce the same two‐level order everywhere
  res_levels <- c(subset_res, "LOMA")
  inoc_levels <- c(subset_res, "LOMA")  # or c("BLOK","LOMA") if that’s all you ever have

  
  subset_plot <- subset_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2,
              shape = reserve_code,
              color = i_code,
              fill = fill_home)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      name   = "Inoculum",
      values = inoc_colors,
      breaks = inoc_levels,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2,
                           title.position="top",
                           direction="horizontal")
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = "Reserve",
                       breaks = res_levels,
                       guide = guide_legend(order = 1,
                                            title.position="top",
                                            direction="horizontal")) +
    # 2) Fill for substrate‐home, transparent if away
  scale_fill_manual(
    name     = "Litter = home",
    values   = reserve_colors,
    na.value = NA,   # away = open
    breaks   = c(subset_res, NA),
    labels = c("home", "away"),
    guide    = guide_legend(
      order = 3,
      title.position="top",
      direction="horizontal",
      override.aes = list(
      shape  = c(15, 0),         # show both circle & triangle
      colour = "black",          # black border for legend keys
      size   = 1.5,
      stroke = 0.5
    ))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.4,0.4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.4,0.4)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
          legend.box         = "horizontal",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 5,
                                      hjust = 0.5,
                                      margin = margin(b = 0.4)),
          legend.key.size    = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.x   = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.y   = unit(0.1,   "cm"),
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
          legend.margin      = margin(t = 0.25, r = 0.2, b = 0.1, l = 0.2),
          legend.text        = element_text(size = 4,
                              margin = margin(l = 1, unit = "pt")),
          text = element_text(size = 4)) +
    labs(title = target_pair)
  
  print(subset_plot)
  # store it
  plot_list[[target_pair]] <- subset_plot
}
```

##### Relative abundance by clade across treatments

```{r Changes in Relative abundance by subclade}


subclades_df_bp <- #subset_taxa(mg, genus == "Curtobacterium") %>%
  tax_glom(rt_curto_rar, taxrank = "subclade") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(., function(x) {x/sum(x)}) %>% 
  psmelt() %>% #melt to long format
  mutate(subclade = factor(subclade, levels = subclds)) %>%
  filter(Bag_type == "Closed" & i_code != "none") |>
  arrange(subclade) |>
  mutate(pair = case_when(
      # if the focal site is LOMA, name it “LOMA vs <other>”
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code == "LOMA"  ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      # if the inoculum is LOMA, also name it “LOMA vs <other reserve>”
      reserve_code != "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      # otherwise fall back to the regular “A vs B”
      reserve_code == "LOMA" & i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste(i_code, "vs", "LOMA"),
      TRUE                         ~ paste(s_code, "vs", "LOMA")),
         reserve_litter = case_when(reserve_code == "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & LOMA",
                                    reserve_code == "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & non-LOMA",
                                    reserve_code != "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "away & LOMA",
                                    reserve_code != "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "away & non-LOMA"),
         inoc_litter = case_when(i_code == "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & LOMA",
                                 i_code == "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "LOMA & non-LOMA",
                                 i_code != "LOMA" & s_code == "LOMA" ~ "away & LOMA",
                                 i_code != "LOMA" & s_code != "LOMA" ~ "away & non-LOMA"),
         i_r_l = case_when(i_code == "LOMA" ~ paste(i_code, reserve_litter, sep = "|"),
                           i_code != "LOMA"  ~ paste("away", reserve_litter, sep = "|")))

plot_paths_RA <- tribble(
 ~source, ~path, ~step, ~i_r_l,
  "LOMA", "Climate",      0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Climate",      1L,    "LOMA|away & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Climate",      2L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       1L,    "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Litter",       2L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  0L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  1L,    "LOMA|away & non-LOMA",
  "LOMA", "Interaction",  2L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      1L,    "away|LOMA & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Climate",      2L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       0L,    "away|away & non-LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       1L,    "away|away & LOMA",
  "away", "Litter",       2L,    "LOMA|LOMA & LOMA"
)




# 2. Extract the LOMA‐vs‐LOMA rows
lomavs <- subclades_df_bp %>%
  filter(i_code == "LOMA" & pair == "LOMA vs LOMA")
```

#### Comm. distances vs env. gradients

```{r pair comm distance along climate}

paths_df_dists <- paths_df |>
  left_join(pca_clim_df2, by = "pair") |>
  left_join(litt_dists_toLOMA, by = "pair")

paths_df_dists_euc <- paths_df_euc |>
  left_join(pca_clim_df2, by = "pair") |>
  left_join(litt_dists_toLOMA, by = "pair")




# 1) Tidy the data -------------------------------------------
df <- paths_df_dists_euc %>%
  filter(path  %in%  c("LOMA_clim_eff", "away_clim_eff"))
  
# 2) Correlations & simple LM --------------------------------
ct_pear  <- cor.test(df$clim_dist_to_LOMA, df$D_S0_S1, method = "pearson")
ct_spear <- cor.test(df$clim_dist_to_LOMA, df$D_S0_S1, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
m        <- lm(eta1 ~ D_S0_S1, data = df)
R2       <- summary(m)$r.squared

ann_lab <- sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f (p = %.3f)\nSpearman \u03C1 = %.2f (p = %.3f)\nR\u00B2 = %.2f",
                   ct_pear$estimate,  ct_pear$p.value,
                   ct_spear$estimate, ct_spear$p.value,
                   R2)

# 3) Plot -----------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = clim_dist_to_LOMA, y = D_S0_S1, label = reserve)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3, min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Community distance vs. climate distance (to LOMA)",
    x = "Climate distance to LOMA",
    y = "Community distance to LOMA (Bray–Curtis of centroids)"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           label = ann_lab, size = 3.5) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p)

ggsave(file =  "~/SyncFolder/CA_curto/RTs/mg_analysis/results/plots/comm_clim_dist_corr.png",
       width = 120*1.1,
       height = 120,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300)



plot_corr_dist <- function(data,
                           x_var,
                           y_var,
                           label_var    = reserve,
                           filter_paths = c("LOMA_clim_eff", "away_clim_eff"),
                           x_titles     = NULL,     
                           y_titles     = NULL,       
                           title        = "auto",      # "auto", NULL (no title), or custom string
                           x_lab        = NULL,
                           y_lab        = NULL,
                           save_path    = NULL,
                           width        = 120 * 1.1,
                           height       = 120,
                           dpi          = 300) {

    # ── Helper: path code → expression (for axis titles) ──────────────────────
  path_to_expr <- function(path_name) {
    lookup <- list(
      LOMA_clim_eff = expression(italic(S)[climate]),
      LOMA_litt_eff = expression(italic(S)[litter]),
      LOMA_int_eff  = expression(italic(S)[interaction]),
      away_clim_eff = expression(italic(A)[climate]),
      away_litt_eff = expression(italic(A)[litter])
    )
       if (path_name %in% names(lookup)) lookup[[path_name]] else NULL
  }

  # ── Helper: combine multiple path expressions into one ────────────────────
  #    e.g. c("LOMA_clim_eff", "away_clim_eff") → "italic(S)[climate] + italic(A)[climate]"
  paths_to_expr <- function(paths) {
    # Build a plotmath string, then parse it
    lookup <- c(
      LOMA_clim_eff = "italic(S)[climate]",
      LOMA_litt_eff = "italic(S)[litter]",
      LOMA_int_eff  = "italic(S)[interaction]",
      away_clim_eff = "italic(Sa)[climate]",
      away_litt_eff = "italic(Sa)[litter]"
    )
    matched <- lookup[intersect(paths, names(lookup))]
    if (length(matched) == 0) return(NULL)
    parse(text = paste(matched, collapse = " * ' + ' * "))
  }

  # ── Helper: path codes → readable string (for plot titles) ────────────────
  path_to_string <- function(path_name) {
    lookup <- c(
      LOMA_clim_eff = "L-climate",
      LOMA_litt_eff = "L-litter",
      LOMA_int_eff  = "L-interaction",
      away_clim_eff = "A-climate",
      away_litt_eff = "A-litter"
    )
    if (path_name %in% names(lookup)) lookup[[path_name]] else path_name
  }

  # 0) Prepare data -----------------------------------------------------------
  df <- data %>%
    filter(path %in% filter_paths)

  x_vals <- pull(df, {{ x_var }})
  y_vals <- pull(df, {{ y_var }})

  x_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(x_var))
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(y_var))

  # ── Guard: need at least 3 complete (finite) pairs ────────────────────────
  complete <- is.finite(x_vals) & is.finite(y_vals)
  n_ok     <- sum(complete)

  if (n_ok < 3) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "Skipping %s vs %s: only %d finite observation(s) (need ≥ 3).",
      y_name, x_name, n_ok
    ))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # 1) Correlations & simple LM ----------------------------------------------
  ct_pear  <- cor.test(x_vals, y_vals, method = "pearson")
  ct_spear <- cor.test(x_vals, y_vals, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

  fml       <- reformulate(x_name, response = y_name)
  m         <- lm(fml, data = df)
  m_summary <- summary(m)
  R2        <- m_summary$r.squared
  R2_pval   <- pf(m_summary$fstatistic[1],
                   m_summary$fstatistic[2],
                   m_summary$fstatistic[3],
                   lower.tail = FALSE)

  ann_lab <- sprintf(
    "Pearson r = %.2f (p = %.3f)\nSpearman \u03C1 = %.2f (p = %.3f)\nR\u00B2 = %.2f (p = %.3f)",
    ct_pear$estimate,  ct_pear$p.value,
    ct_spear$estimate, ct_spear$p.value,
    R2, R2_pval
  )

 # 2) Build axis titles ------------------------------------------------------
   #    x-axis: explicit x_lab > x_titles lookup > raw column name
  if (is.null(x_lab)) {
    x_lab <- if (!is.null(x_titles) && x_name %in% names(x_titles)) {
      x_titles[[x_name]]
    } else {
      x_name
    }
  }
 #    y-axis: explicit y_lab > y_titles lookup > auto expression from paths > raw column name  
  if (is.null(y_lab)) {
    if (!is.null(y_titles) && y_name %in% names(y_titles)) {
      y_lab <- y_titles[[y_name]]
    } else {
     # Auto: build expression from filter_paths
      y_lab_expr <- paths_to_expr(filter_paths)
      if (!is.null(y_lab_expr)) {
        y_lab <- y_lab_expr
      } else {
        y_lab <- y_name
      }
    }
  }

  # 3) Build plot title -------------------------------------------------------
  pathway_str <- paste(sapply(filter_paths, path_to_string), collapse = " + ")

  plot_title <- if (is.null(title)) {
   NULL
  } else if (identical(title, "auto")) {
    sprintf("%s vs. %s  [%s]", y_name, x_lab, pathway_str)
  } else {
    title
  }

  # 4) Plot -------------------------------------------------------------------
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = {{ y_var }}, label = {{ label_var }})) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3, min.segment.length = 0) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    ylim(-0.3,1) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
             label = ann_lab, size = 3.5) +
    theme_minimal()


  print(p)

  # 5) Optionally save --------------------------------------------------------
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(filename = save_path,
           plot     = p,
           width    = width,
           height   = height,
           units    = "mm",
           dpi      = dpi,
           bg = "white")
  }

  # 6) Return -----------------------------------------------------------------
  invisible(list(
    plot     = p,
    pearson  = ct_pear,
    spearman = ct_spear,
    lm_model = m,
    R2       = R2,
    R2_pval  = R2_pval,
    data     = df
  ))
}

plot_corr_dist_combos <- function(data,
                                  x_vars,
                                  y_vars,
                                  filter_paths_list = list(c("LOMA_clim_eff", "away_clim_eff")),
                                  label_var         = reserve,
                                  x_titles          = NULL,    # NEW
                                  y_titles          = NULL,    # NEW
                                  title             = "auto",  # NEW
                                  save_dir          = NULL,
                                  width             = 120 * 1.1,
                                  height            = 120,
                                  dpi               = 300) {


  # 1) Build the grid of all combinations ------------------------------------
  #    x_vars / y_vars are character vectors; filter_paths_list is a named or

  #    unnamed list of character vectors.

  #    Give each filter_paths entry a short id for file names
  fp_ids <- if (!is.null(names(filter_paths_list))) {
    names(filter_paths_list)
  } else {
    paste0("fp", seq_along(filter_paths_list))
  }

  combos <- expand.grid(
    x_var  = x_vars,
    y_var  = y_vars,
    fp_id  = fp_ids,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Map fp_id back to the actual filter_paths vector
  combos$filter_paths <- filter_paths_list[combos$fp_id]

  # Drop combos where x == y (optional — remove this line if you want them)
  combos <- combos[combos$x_var != combos$y_var, ]

  message(sprintf("Running %d combinations …", nrow(combos)))

  # 2) Iterate over every combination ----------------------------------------
  results <- purrr::pmap(combos, function(x_var, y_var, fp_id, filter_paths) {

    message(sprintf("  ▸ x = %s | y = %s | filter = %s", x_var, y_var, fp_id))

    # Build an optional save path
    save_path <- if (!is.null(save_dir)) {
      file.path(save_dir,
                sprintf("corr_%s_vs_%s_%s.png", y_var, x_var, fp_id))
    } else {
      NULL
    }

    # Use rlang::sym() to convert strings → symbols for tidy evaluation
    tryCatch(
      plot_corr_dist(
        data         = data,
        x_var        = !!rlang::sym(x_var),
        y_var        = !!rlang::sym(y_var),
        label_var    = {{ label_var }},
        filter_paths = filter_paths,
        x_titles     = x_titles,      # NEW
        y_titles     = y_titles,       # NEW
        title        = title,
        save_path    = save_path,
        width        = width,
        height       = height,
        dpi          = dpi
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("  ✖ Failed for x = %s, y = %s, filter = %s:\n    %s",
                        x_var, y_var, fp_id, conditionMessage(e)))
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
  })

  # 3) Name the list for easy access ----------------------------------------
  names(results) <- paste(combos$y_var, "vs", combos$x_var, combos$fp_id,
                          sep = "_")

  message("Done!")
   # Summary
  n_ok   <- sum(!vapply(results, is.null, logical(1)))
  n_fail <- sum(vapply(results, is.null, logical(1)))
  message(sprintf("Done! %d succeeded, %d skipped/failed.", n_ok, n_fail))
  
  invisible(results)
}
```
